$comment: TRO-455 / PF-603 threshold config, committed per the PRD's own AC ('threshold config in repo'). totalBudgetMs is the graded number (PLUGFORGE.MD §5: 'TTFE CI P95 < 60 s'). stageBudgetsMs are independent, generous per-stage ceilings that exist to name WHICH stage regressed rather than only that the run was slow — they deliberately sum to well more than totalBudgetMs (82000 > 60000): a single stage can legitimately consume most of the total budget on a slow CI runner without any one stage being individually pathological. Read together with scripts/drill/thresholds.ts's own header before changing either number.
